steps.text: The roaring golden ocean smashes against Rhodes Island. The sovereigns' will sinks into the sea of infinity, then rises up again at the only ship upon the waves.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Will the echoes of the kings never cease while the voices of the myriad remains?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: No, it is not just the roar of the myriad souls that is causing this. That tower—

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: It's trembling. The tremors at the root have stirred the tides.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: You have encountered them...

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I could not see the end of this tower that stretches beyond the heavens, even if I etched incantations into my eyes.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Originium has obstructed my sight.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Is this your way of telling me that it is not my battlefield to intervene?
The waves answer the Banshee's call. The sovereigns beckon.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I will not yield.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I have promised with my song to they who have gone beyond the other side of the tower—

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Ever shall Rhodes Island be our terra firma; never will it sink beneath the waves.
The young Sarkaz raises his bone pen and steps towards the void, writing incantations upon the waves.
The waves attempt to break free of their shackles, but the Banshee is silent.
He peers up at the sky, listening to the sound of the tower trembling.
He knows that King and King are clashing against one another, beyond where his eyes could see.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: This is your war, Amiya... it's not my place to intervene.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I can only pray for your safe return.
'I can calm the angry roar of the myriad souls...'
'But the only true answer lies in cutting off the source of all our suffering.'
'What is suffering to us Sarkaz?'
'Is it the brief respite by the only candle in the dark mines after a long day of working in ice and snow?'
'Is it the murder of the children of a Sarkaz and a Liberi who truly love each other, committed by the fanatics of the frontiers solely out of fear of their appearances?'
'Or polishing our horns day after day, spending our entire life living in fear wearing a Caprinae disguise?'
'A Sarkaz may encounter countless forms of injustice and suffering in their lifetime...'
'Injustice has become the norm, the entirety of their lives...'
'Such that when they are asked what suffering is...'
'They could not answer.'
Atop the tower, the pure-white figure gazes down at you.
'The King of Sarkaz.'
You have spent so much time with that Cautus girl that you have forgotten the implications of this title until now.
Theresa was not the King of Sarkaz simply because of the crown.
What kind of strength, wisdom and cunning does it take to convince all Sarkaz to willingly, gladly call her their king?
Massive energies rush out from the tower, forming white threads and silk that stretch on and on without end, permitting no resistance.

options: I have never seen Arts of this kind.
None of the stories about Theresa ever told of anything like this.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Before she was the King, Theresa was a caster the likes of which is only seen once in a thousand years.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We're on her home ground.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This is not witchcraft, nor any power of the King of Sarkaz that I know of.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She is reconstructing and utilizing the information inherent within Originium.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Observe and understand what she's doing, Doctor. Help Amiya and W resist her attacks!

steps.name: W
steps.text: This suffocating presence...

steps.name: W
steps.text: The feeling of impending death... she truly wants to...

steps.name: W
steps.text: No, there's no way! The real Theresa would never—
'The real Theresa'?
She cannot help but mock the ridiculous notion.
She casts her eyes at the familiar, yet impassive Theresa.

steps.name: W
steps.text: *Sarkaz expletive*, only one thing to do!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Damn it, these strange limits she's set have made my bombs useless.

steps.name: W
steps.text: We're all done for, if this thing keeps falling!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Do something, hag!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Ordinary measures are of no use here, not even Originium Arts.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That doesn't mean she can't be defeated. At least—

steps.name: W
steps.text: You mean the bunny?
She looks towards Amiya, still resisting the overwhelming Arts. A black crown floats above her head.

options: The power of the King can break through the limits of Originium.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I don't have a clue what you're talking about, but—

steps.name: W
steps.text: Right now, I guess I've got to trust you and the bunny.
W realizes that she started believing in Amiya a long time ago.
As she did on the burning command tower in Chernobog, when the bunny delivered the box with the key in it into her hands...
She believed that the city would stop.
W looks at the girl. She almost sees Theresa.
Theresa chose Amiya.
The one Theresa chose would not disappoint Theresa, or W.

steps.name: W
steps.text: If you're all bound up in the myriad souls—

steps.name: W
steps.text: I'll blow the myriad souls to pieces.
She begins to move.
She never hesitates or doubts herself.
The only thing she feels is excitement, the moment she came up with the brilliant idea of blowing those blasted myriad souls to pieces.
As she does whenever she goes into battle.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Bunny!

steps.name: W
steps.text: I know you can hear me!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: W, I—

steps.name: W
steps.text: Don't turn around! Focus!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Use your magic rings to link me directly to the *Sarkaz expletive* myriad souls!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What—?

steps.name: W
steps.text: You can do that, right?

steps.name: W
steps.text: I know the Confessarii did something to bind the myriad souls to Her Highness. Let me hear what the old garbage told her—

steps.name: W
steps.text: Then I'll blow them to pieces. THEN I'll find a chance to talk to Her Highness.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'll try!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Just be careful!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Enough talking, I'm ready—
W hears voices innumerable, but it is not as she had imagined.
She thought she would hear angry roars like the revenant's, but the voices are far calmer than she expected.
They quietly tell of countless lives and deaths as Sarkaz.
The sigh of relief when drifting farmers finally find a land to settle on. The last pleas of Infected thrown alive to the furnaces.
The futile howl of dying soldiers forced to watch their city conquered. The helpless cries of hungry children lying weakly on their beds.
So many different upbringings and circumstances, all bestowed a tragic fate just because they were Sarkaz.
Their joy, their anger, the emotions amplified by the span of nine thousand years—
If this was what Theresa was always listening to... why?
Was it the myriad souls' will that the twin kings came to be again? Was it their will that sent the Sarkaz into this war?
The Sarkaz engrave their sorrows into the myriad souls, and the will of the myriad souls leads those who come after on a similar path. This is a tragic cycle.
Hate ignites hate. Sorrow reflects sorrow.
...Is that all?
W feels like she is being swept along by a rapid current.
Her life is also amongst the voices of the myriad souls.
'I will detonate things and defend things.'
'I will destroy things and direct things.'
'They're living, breathing people, W.'
'I don't need you to tell me, Ines. Hoederer taught me the difference between people and things.'
Yes, W has seen all that the myriad souls speak of. No one knows the life of the Sarkaz better than she does.
She has seen plenty, from the Scar Market of Kazdel to the ships of Babel, from the ruins of Chernobog to the battlefields of Londinium.
She has never contemplated the meaning within, for what she must do is far from complicated.
Need shelter against wind and rain? Light a fire, build a tent. Enemies in the way? Shell them, bomb them, whatever it takes.
It was never the murmur of the myriad souls that kept her going, but the tiny speck of light ahead.
W keeps searching, searching, and finally finds the voice that she wanted the most.
'All of you deserve to live. Yes, you too.'
'I remember you, mercenary.'
'They gave you the code name W, didn't they?'
Your Highness... we meet again.
Whether you're the real one or not, I don't exactly have a choice, do I?
Now I remember why you captivated me.
The King of Sarkaz, yet so unlike the Sarkaz.
You showed me that the Sarkaz need not be miserable.
So, let's forget the myriad souls for a while.

steps.name: W
steps.text: No need to shout, bunny. I know you're there. You were peeking into my memory, weren't you?

steps.name: W
steps.text: If Ines was still around, she would have—

steps.name: W
steps.text: Bah, no time to think about that.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Maybe I can't barge into a fight between Kings of Sarkaz, but I can break Her Highness free from the interference of the myriad souls.
W can feel her connection with the myriad souls with the help of Amiya's Arts.
Emotions converge before her, emotions that belong to her...
Joy.
Regret.
Anger.
Relief...
The Black Crown magnifies her emotions.
She recalls her past, savoring her experiences.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Coming face to face with my entire life... interesting.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Is extracting myself from the myriad souls the only way to get it to quiet down?
The emotions take shape, and she grabs the colorful object in her hand.
It is her emotions, the experiences of her entire life.
Intangible threads stretch from the 'self' to the chaos in the distance, the myriad souls.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Is this what you deal with all the time, little bunny?

steps.name: W
steps.text: What you see is probably much better than this.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Her Highness... she looked at me like this, once, didn't she?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Thanks, Amiya.
W points her gun at the myriad souls.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Watch, bunny.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Watch how my present's gonna surprise Her Highness!

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You... you attacked the myriad souls directly.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: No one has ever managed to interrupt their voices... I'm surprised at what you have achieved, Amiya, W.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But why... why does Theresa look completely unaffected?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Your Highness...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (W, come back! What are you trying to do?)

steps.name: W
steps.text: (There's something I have to know...)

steps.name: W
steps.text: (Maybe Her Highness will listen to us—)
She stops. Theresa sees her, and she sees Theresa's expression.
Maybe, maybe...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I see what you're thinking, W.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You believe that the will of the myriad souls has warped my judgment...

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...Pretty much?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Not that I sympathize with the Victorians. I just don't think your original goal was to help Theresis make this Originium that turns all of Terra on its head.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Maybe you can just pause this thing for a moment, let us get out of... whatever this place is, and then we could talk about how—

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: The W I remember wasn't one to offer truces like this.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You're afraid.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Shouldn't I be? I pick my fights too, you know.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: No... you're afraid that the beacon you have followed for so long is nothing more than an illusion.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You're afraid you might be the one to break the facade.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: But you must face it...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Wha—
There is no wind in this place, but the static air begins to flow.
Clouds gather and disperse by the tower, soft and light, like white flowers brought to bloom by the wind.
Theresa stands in the middle of the sea of flowers, and a symbol begins to appear at her feet—

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You recognize this, Dr. {@nickname}.
Her voice is confident.
It is as though, here and now, or perhaps in the distant past... your emotions and memories had been tightly linked.
You are familiar with the symbol. Why a rhombus, though?
It exists everywhere in this 'universe', within Originium.
Most of the time, it hangs in the heavens, seemingly a harmless source of light. W and the others would not think much of an unusual 'star' in the sky.
But you know that this is not right.
If heaven and earth could be reversed... how could this 'star' be a planar figure?

a.text: I share with you now the universe in my eyes, Dr. {@nickname}.

spans.text: I share with you now the universe in my eyes, Dr. {@nickname}.

a.text: If destruction is the boundary that no life may cross, and all exploration and evolution must eventually reach an end—

spans.text: If destruction is the boundary that no life may cross, and all exploration and evolution must eventually reach an end—

a.text: Then this is our only future.

spans.text: Then this is our only future.

options: The rhombus... the symbol of Originium.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Whatever you just recalled, Dr. {@nickname}, don't go any further.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This is dangerous. Very dangerous.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Don't look at the rhombuses. Don't let them... notice you.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Don't worry, Kal'tsit. This tower is safe, for now.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Theresa...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You took the most dangerous step after all.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I still remember the knowledge you and Dr. {@nickname} shared with me.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Kal'tsit... Has the garden near Kazdel turned back into wasteland?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...I went back to check on it, once.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Many storms had passed through. Active Originium had reshaped the landscape.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: All the entrances were covered in Originium clusters. It was impossible to tell if our experiment site had been destroyed or not.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: It's fine. Just some beautiful but impossible dreams. Let them fade away in storm.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Our goal can only be achieved here.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The inside of Originium...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You described to me how to reverse the Assimilated Universe, to utilize, even alter the information inherent in Originium.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Through the Shard and the cradle that hangs high in the heavens, I finally set foot in the land where truth lies.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: The golden ocean sits tranquil above our heads. All information is with us, free from the restrictions of space and time.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I did it, finally.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: The Sarkaz retrieved the first Originium from deep within the land ten thousand years ago. It has returned to the Sarkaz, at long last.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: In time, Kazdel will truly become a garden free from the torment of Catastrophe and Oripathy.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Will you still oppose me, despite all that?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I remember the dream that Theresa described to me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: A safe and equal home, where Originium is fully under control, and there is no Oripathy or Catastrophe, no schism between the Infected and uninfected.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But soldiers are still dying on the battlefield. Innocent people are still being driven from their homes by war.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Does this home still have room for people other than Sarkaz, in this plan of yours?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: ...I'm sorry.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Then Originium will not be the hope for the eternal existence that you once dreamed of.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It will only become a weapon for the Sarkaz to bring even more destruction.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This was not Theresa's dream.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Then we must become enemies.

a.text: That's why you must keep going.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Theresa...?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: The erstwhile King of Sarkaz, builder of Kazdel and supreme leader of Babel stands before you.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I shall fulfill the King of Sarkaz's duties to the bitter end. I shall fight for the sake of the Sarkaz, as I have for centuries.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: All who stand before me, all who try to stop me, are the enemy of the Sarkaz.

a.text: All those dreams and promises that I could not fulfill, you can.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No... this is not your will...
I heard it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: —Look out!
Black tide clashes with black tide. King clashes with King.
Amiya's black Arts are reduced to nothing the moment they touch Theresa. Black threads are pulled away from around Amiya, re-converging in Theresa's palm.
Countless white threads rush out from Theresa's hand.
They tightly surround Amiya.
Like a soft dress, or a blossom whose blooming process had been reversed.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ugh—!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Bunny!
Theresa's silhouette fades in the smoke of the explosion. Where she had stood, the outline of a thorn-shaped crown becomes increasingly distinct.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Didn't work?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Is that the power of the King of Sarkaz too?!

options: This is the power of Originium.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...She did it.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Theresa is emulating the Black Crown with Originium.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is far beyond the powers of the King of Sarkaz that I'm able to wield...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor! Dr. Kal'tsit! Behind me!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'll protect you—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Theresa—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Theresa—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Theresa...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She promised to take me outside to pick flowers today. Where is she?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: In a meeting with the Doctor? Or visiting the wards with Dr. Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Theresa is busy. I shouldn't disturb her. I'll go to the cafeteria and get lunch for her!
The sun shines brightly on the spotless deck. The wind is warm, mixed with the smell of wilderness and flowers.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I... This is...
The Cautus girl turns around and sees her onetime self running happily on the deck.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is... the Civilight Eterna system.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: This is your memory. I can see it.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You hear the whispers of my heart, know everything I'm thinking about.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: And vice versa.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You remember it all...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You were always the same Theresa... all along...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: It's been a while, Amiya.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I'm very happy to see you all grown up.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I... I'm really happy to see you again...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Give me a little bit of time. I want to take a good look at you.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I've always wanted to know how things have been for you all these years.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I can see them... all the fighting and the loss that you've experienced throughout the journey. I see it all.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: All I want is a little more time...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What is it that you're looking at?
She casts her gaze towards the distance, but there is nothing on the deck.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: It was such a happy time.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I thought you were an unfortunate child who needed to be cared for closely. But it was you who brought so much comfort to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: It took me a long time to realize that meeting you was the luckiest thing in my life.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But... why me?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Let's go out for a walk, shall we?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Where are you going?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: My home, Kazdel.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I always wanted to take you here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You told me many stories of what happened there.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But Babel never made it back to Kazdel...
There was no need for questions.
Amiya feels Theresa's every choice, every struggle.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I understand that war now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You had no choice.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: We have already made a choice when we say, 'There is no choice.'

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I had to choose the path that was better for Sarkaz.
This race has been through too much hardship. Every step it takes is heavy and labored.
If Sarkaz needed someone to show them a new path, she would take up the banner first; if the price of Sarkaz unity was the death of their king, she would be the one to step up.
The protector is inevitably also the persecutor, Amiya.
As we gain, so do we take away.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Theresa I knew always chose the path of peace.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's what Babel and Rhodes Island are for... isn't it?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Babel exists because of all of you.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: The watchman who carries the burden of civilization, the sage who holds the key, the genius mercenary who gains free will, and the innocent child compassionate for all life.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: And Logos, Mantra, Scout, Ace... countless souls that shine so bright.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You have overcome the barriers of race, upbringing and disease. You share a sincere friendship and unwavering dream.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Through the tribulations of war and the obstacle of reality, you continue to stand together and stand by me.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: That was how Babel was founded.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: It was never I who made you members of Babel.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: It was you who made a clothesmaker who picked up a crown, one of countless Kings of Sarkaz, Theresa of Babel.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You can achieve what I could not.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thank you... Theresa.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Will you hear me tell one more story, Amiya?
Not an epic of heroic warriors protecting their home, nor a legend of a King of Sarkaz's reign.
Just a story of an ordinary Sarkaz girl, who lived a little longer than the ordinary person.
Born in Kazdel, she saw the few families and friends she had suffer in constant cold and hunger, trembling in fear in the darkness every night, waiting for the sun to rise again.
She wanted the people around her to live in happiness, to have a safe home. She would do anything for this.
She remained ever true to this wish.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Then why...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why must we fight you?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Not every meeting has a beautiful ending, Amiya.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I've left once. This time, we have the chance to say goodbye.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You saw the myriad souls, Amiya. They struggled against fate all their lives. They don't want to be used and imprisoned even unto death.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: The same is true for me.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You must defeat me, Amiya.
Only then can you carry on my unfulfilled dream.
Only then can you release me.
'Fate' should not exist, Amiya.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You have remained the good girl that I saw the first day we met, no matter how much you went through.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Perhaps you would not have to bear so much pain, if you weren't so brave, so gentle.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is this... that day?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You held me in your arms, told me stories, until...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Theresa... can you stop?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I've stopped, Amiya. I'm not reading your memories.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is my own power. We are inside your memories.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Yes, Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm sorry, Theresa... I couldn't help myself.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: It's not you who should say sorry.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Becoming the King of Sarkaz means carrying the emotions of the many, but the emotions that belong to ourselves are there as well.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I've lost much in my life, Amiya, but I don't have many regrets.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: The only regret I have is you. From past to present, I never wanted to leave you.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I am happy about your growth, but I should have been there for you.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I should have been there to teach you how to use the powers of the King of Sarkaz.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Now, though, is your chance to prove to me, the erstwhile King of Sarkaz—
Heat saps at reason, flames scorching the soul.
A sword forms within the flame, taking shape in Theresa's hand.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: 'Wrath'.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's... my sword!

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You will hear the seething anger of that Sarkaz sovereign when you hold this sword in your hand.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You have grabbed this sword from the wrath of the past which once declared war upon injustice...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: The sword of the King of Sarkaz shall ever point towards the enemy of Sarkaz.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: The sword of the King of Sarkaz shall ever slay the enemy of Sarkaz.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: But we have come this far, and yet prejudice lives, and hostility threatens to smother us.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: The Kings of Sarkaz of the past have failed. The Theresa of the past has failed—
Amiya sees it all.
Theresa wandering in the darkness, seeking an answer.
Theresa standing in the halls of the airship, gazing down at the battle below.
Theresa waking up alone from death, no friend or comrade around her.
Theresa—pointing her sword at a child.
Such sorrow.
Amiya could barely move under the overwhelming sorrow.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Now, you hold a sword as well.
Amiya feels a weight in her hand.
The sword, which had slain an evil god, had returned to her hand.
Formless flame warms her palm.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You... how?!
Black tides ripple from Theresa, turning into threads that lead Amiya's hand—
The sword points at Theresa.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: This is my final gift to you, Amiya.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Feel my power, my emotions, my will...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Make them a part of you.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: They will be by your side... in my place.
The sword in Amiya's hand trembles, but not out of fear or excitement.
She can feel Theresa's will fill it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I've always remembered, Theresa.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I remember every story you told me, the words you whispered into my ear.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I never had the chance to tell you—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm so, so glad that I met you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And...
The sword pierces Amiya's own chest.
Amiya holds Theresa's hand tightly, pushing the sword further in.
It is not that there is no pain.
It is simply that all the pain has been wrapped in layer of warmth.
Tears begin to fall from Theresa's face—
Falling into Amiya's eyes.
The black sword shatters.
A warm and gentle power surrounds Amiya's fingertips.
It is sorrow...
And the purest love.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I will.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I will inherit the legacy of Civilight Eterna.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I will become the King of Sarkaz.
